name: shard
author: Peppxrr
description: Medal-style game clipper — RAM replay buffer, hotkeys, library, editor, Discord-size exports.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json
scripts.test:editor: node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-editor.mjs && node scripts/test-editor-timeline.mjs && node scripts/test-editor-player.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/release.mjs validate && node scripts/release.mjs notes && node scripts/verify-core-bin.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.test:themes: node scripts/test-themes.mjs && node scripts/test-ui-popovers.mjs && node scripts/test-builtin-themes.mjs
